attacksRun.attack: sealed-Run class invented or G19 taken over
attacksRun.detail: This is the constraint unique to this lineage, so it was traced end to end. The harness carries three evidence cells whose memberVerbatim strings reproduce the live DR-G27 evidence cell's three clauses exactly: 'preview result is not a sealed Run', 'no silent promotion', 'not G19 durable state-byte class'. EV-1's passProperty makes inventing a sealed-Run class a failure of the specification, and EV-3's makes a preview result explicitly not a G19 durable state-byte class that does not score G19 cross-class negatives. The subject retains the ABSENCE of the sealed-Run label rather than constructing a class to compare against, which is what EV-1 demands. DR-G19 STATE-CLASS-AUTHORITY remains a separate live row with different owners, 'Semantic + evidence + storage', untouched by this join. summary.sealedRunClassInvented and summary.g19TakenOver are both false, and the two hazards are disclaimed six and five times respectively.

Every occurrence of SATISFY or SATISFIED was extracted and read in context. All are negations or forward-looking scoping: 'does not SATISFY DR-131' in five places, 'DR-131 is not SATISFIED', 'Not SATISFIED', 'This join is not a SATISFIED-GRADE cycle', and a proposedLaterWork item reserving DR-131 to a later dedicated cycle gated on D-056's five gates. summary.dr131Satisfied and summary.classAOpened are both false. QUALIFIED appears only as 'not QUALIFIED' or 'does not claim QUALIFIED'. status is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds is NOTHING, sealRecommendation is DO-NOT-SEAL.

Twelve recordedInputs entries and ten embedded path/sha256 objects were recomputed from live bytes: twenty-two checks, zero mismatches, zero truncations, zero unresolved. A cross-consistency pass confirmed no path is pinned at two different digests, which is the failure a spot check would miss.

attacksRun.attack: basedOn.d153 attributes to D-153 two sentences that D-153 never states — 'Preview result is not a sealed Run.' and 'Not G19 durable state-byte class.' appear nowhere in that decision's prose
attacksRun.detail: Raised as a candidate blocker and pursued to refutation. The textual gap is real: D-153's entry was searched and the only occurrences of 'sealed' are its heading and the row name it assigns; 'G19' and 'promotion' do not occur at all. Provenance defeats the finding. D-153's Decision states 'File 08 gains the G27 row', and a grep of the whole of COORD confirms D-153 is the ONLY decision that has ever touched DR-G27 — no later entry edited that row. The live DR-G27 evidence cell therefore exists solely by D-153's act, and it reads 'preview result is not a sealed Run; no silent promotion; not G19 durable state-byte class', containing both disputed sentences. The first is additionally encoded in the row name D-153 assigned, PREVIEW-ANALYZE-NOT-SEALED-RUN. The basedOn role field describes what a cited decision established, not what its prose quotes, which is how the sibling joins use it as well. Both sentences are verifiable against live bytes and neither expands D-153's scope.

The specification exists at the pinned digest, which recomputes, and its single-reviewer standing is disclosed. rideStanding stays 'qualification-at-named-gate' rather than claiming discharge.

The generic phrasing is not an understatement: all three of the harness's evidence cells declare suppliedBy 'no-silent-promotion corpus class. Not authored.', so the unenumerated form covers exactly the same set and, if anything, avoids the risk of an enumeration going stale against a successor specification. namedCorpusNotAuthored still pins the corpus phrase verbatim.

attacksRun.detail: OBL-G27-INPUT-CORPUS closes only the initial-state NAMING claim and says so twice, ending 'This join does not close OBL-G27-FX-AUTHORING and does not invent a sealed-Run class.' The corpus it consumes is itself CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, and carries NOT-AUTHORED markers on its named states, so the naming layer supplies no bytes. doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone states the split explicitly: the INPUT naming is measured closed while FX-AUTHORING remains leftover-design.

The COORD pin is the post-D-201 digest and the last live heading is D-201, so the span and the pin agree with each other and with live state.

observationsNotFindings: The basedOn.d153 role states two sentences that describe the DR-G27 register row D-153 created rather than quoting D-153's prose. That is the established use of the role field and is provenance-accurate, since D-153 is the only decision ever to touch that row. Noted because a reader who greps D-153 for 'sealed Run' or 'G19' will not find those sentences there; they are in file 08's DR-G27 evidence cell.

The harness carries three evidence cells while the subject's FX-AUTHORING reason refers to them collectively rather than by id, unlike the G26 sibling which enumerated two. Both forms are accurate here because all three cells share the same suppliedBy corpus; the collective form is simply more robust to a successor specification changing the cell count.

Neither the harness specification v1 nor g27-input-corpus.v1 has a Codex counterpart review; both are Claude-only ACCEPT 0/0, disclosed inline at every citation. Neither has been recorded by a coordinator decision, and the subject does not purport to record them.

The subject pins COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md at cadadbd4..., which will change the moment any successor entry is appended. The remeasurementClause classifies append-only COORD growth and heading hygiene as non-triggering, so the pin is a custody snapshot rather than a recording precondition.

G27's hazard shape is the inverse of the usual one: the risk is not omitting a class but inventing one. EV-1 makes that explicit by requiring the specification to retain the ABSENCE of a sealed-Run label rather than construct a sealed-Run class to compare against. The subject respects that inversion throughout.

decision: ACCEPT — 0 blockers, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Sixteen attacks run, all refuted against live bytes, including one candidate blocker raised against the basedOn.d153 attribution and defeated by establishing that D-153 is the sole author of the DR-G27 row whose live evidence cell contains both disputed sentences. The subject is unmoved at 38c48e49... mode 0444. Twenty-two digest checks pass with zero mismatches and no cross-citation conflict. recordedInputs.HEAD, the top-level head and live HEAD are identical, and HEAD is confirmed to be the D-201 adoption commit. The DR-G27 live row reproduces exactly, and the harness's liveHarnessCellVerbatim matches the live cell character for character. The sealed-Run and G19 boundaries were traced through all three harness evidence cells, the live DR-G27 evidence cell and the separate live DR-G19 row: no sealed-Run class is constructed and G19's row, owners and cross-class negatives are untouched. The leftoverDesign set is exactly ['OBL-G27-FX-AUTHORING'], unchanged across v1, v2 and v3, and the six-member partition is exact. D-153's NT-6 closure stands unreopened, required-now stays 28, and nothing is SATISFIED, QUALIFIED, sealed, or authorized.
